title: Writing & Production Laws (sample catalog)
description: Extract-style law cards: psycho_mechanism + rules + enforcement. Full production catalog contains 48+7 laws.

laws.name: Three-act structure
laws.psycho_mechanism: The brain expects setup → conflict → resolution. Without that sequence the dopamine system does not reward completion.
rules: Inciting incident in the first 12% of runtime
laws.violation: Late inciting incident (>15%) → viewer leaves. No all-is-lost → victory feels unearned.

laws.name: Open loop (Zeigarnik)
laws.psycho_mechanism: Unfinished tasks create cognitive tension; the brain demands closure.
rules: Central question in the first 30 seconds
All loops closed by the finale (max 1 sequel hook)
laws.violation: No question asked → no reason to stay. 3+ open loops → frustration.

checks.message: Too many open loops at end

laws.name: Cold open
laws.psycho_mechanism: The first 5–8 seconds decide stay/leave before conscious thought.
rules: Cold open is the most dramatic moment, not a summary
laws.violation: Logo/greeting in the first 5s = viewer gone.

laws.name: Retinal fatigue / micro-impulse
laws.psycho_mechanism: Static frames are fully scanned in ~3.2s; after that retention bleeds ~4%/s without micro-impulses.
rules: Dopamine kick every ~2.8s (zoom pulse / z-shift / tactile cue)
No static visual >3.5s without a kick
